Microsoft Graph API supports OData protocol so that users don't have to worry about
pagination - or requesting the next set of data. However, filtering data is essential to improving
load times in a busy environment.
Microsoft Graph API supports query parameters. Here are few examples of filters used in the
report:
The following query returns the list of alerts generated over the past three days. Using
this query in environments with high volumes of data might result in hundreds of
megabytes of data that could take a moment to load. By using this hardcoded approach,
you're able to quickly see your most recent alerts over the last three days as soon as you
open the report.
